event_selections.selection_rationale: Frames n240-n359 show a sequence of persistent caption cards (ダブステップ→あいつ→スポーツ→ダンス), each a large light-blue text on white with dashed border. Text changes every ~0.5s but each caption is persistent (not a burst). This is a 'persistent caption/frame' pattern, not 'burst/reflow'.

Frames n870-n929 show brush-stroke characters that burst in, disappear, then new characters burst in (々々々→々々が→empty→アケ). This is a 'burst/reflow' pattern with 'glyph/group motion'. Characters are dynamic calligraphy-style with varying colors (blue, black, red).

Frames n2160-n2207 show a persistent scene with: (1) border text 'ARE YOU READY?' repeating around the frame edge (texture/scope), (2) foreground caption 'ちゃんと覚悟してきてよ？' with yellow '覚悟' emphasis (foreground scope), (3) night scene with two black rabbits and lightning bolt (background), (4) white grid outer texture. This clearly separates text/foreground from scene/texture scope.

proposal.baseline_geometry: centered, large (~60-80% frame width), dashed border rectangle around text
proposal.masks_compositing_order: background → dashed border → text fill → Alight Motion label

constructions.minimal_counterexample: a single static caption (no sequence) would be too narrow; the sequence is the key feature
constructions.lyric_emotion_fit: fits upbeat, playful, rapid-fire lyrics; each word is a beat; avoid slow/meditative lyrics (timing too fast)
constructions.image_relation: text is primary content; background is minimal/geometric; no characters
constructions.avoid_cases: do not use for lyrics requiring sustained readability (words change too fast); do not use for serious/meditative tone
constructions.readability_risk: rapid content change may reduce readability if words are complex; dashed border helps frame the text
